Paths are relative to the repository root.

Load input
```{r}
counts = read.delim("data/Gide_log2TPM.txt", row.names = 1)
coldata = read.table("data/colData_all.txt", header = TRUE, sep = " ", quote = "\"")
deconv = read.csv("evaluation/Groundtruth/Scenario1/Results/Deconvolution_Gide.csv", row.names = 1)

# Same sample names as the deconvolution tables (make.names() adds an "X" only to names starting with a digit)
rownames(coldata) = make.names(coldata$rna_id)
```

Subset to Gide
```{r}
coldata_Gide = coldata[coldata$Cohort == "Gide", ]
```

Transform to TPM
```{r}
counts_TPM = 2^as.matrix(counts) - 1
```

```{r}
all.equal(rownames(coldata_Gide), colnames(counts_TPM))
```

Machine learning analysis

Training
```{r}
library(pipeML)
library(multideconv)
library(DeconRNASeq)

# Clinical data in the order of the deconvolution rows (target_var is matched by position)
coldata_Gide = coldata_Gide[rownames(deconv), ]

# Cross-validation with the pipeML defaults: 10 folds x 5 repetitions, seed 123
res <- compute_features.training.ML(features_train = deconv,
                                    target_var = coldata_Gide$Response,
                                    task_type = "classification",
                                    trait.positive = "R",
                                    metric = "AUROC",
                                    file_name = "Training",
                                    ncores = 2,
                                    fold_construction_fun = prepare_multideconv_folds,
                                    fold_construction_args_fixed = list(ncores = 2),
                                    return = TRUE)
```

Prediction

Load data
```{r}
counts_Riaz = read.delim("data/Riaz_log2TPM.txt", row.names = 1)
counts_Riaz = 2^as.matrix(counts_Riaz) - 1
coldata_Riaz = coldata[coldata$Cohort == "Riaz", ]
```

Deconvolution
```{r}
deconv_Riaz = compute.deconvolution(counts_Riaz, normalized = F,
                                    credentials.mail = "marcelo.hurtado@inserm.fr",
                                    credentials.token = "b72981d4d0554bcfffc37472ccd8588d",
                                    file_name = "Riaz")
write.csv(deconv_Riaz, "evaluation/Groundtruth/Scenario3/Results/Deconvolution_Riaz.csv")
deconv_Riaz = read.csv("evaluation/Groundtruth/Scenario3/Results/Deconvolution_Riaz.csv", row.names = 1)

# Clinical data in the order of the deconvolution rows (target_var is matched by position)
coldata_Riaz = coldata_Riaz[rownames(deconv_Riaz), ]
```

Replicate subgroups
```{r}
dt_Riaz = multideconv::replicate_deconvolution_subgroups(deconv_res = res$Custom_output,
                                                         deconvolution_test = deconv_Riaz)
```

Testing
```{r}
pred <- compute_prediction(model = res$Model,
                           test_data = dt_Riaz,
                           target_var = coldata_Riaz$Response,
                           task_type = "classification",
                           trait.positive = "R",
                           file.name = "Prediction",
                           return = T)
pred$AUC
```

SHAP values
```{r}
# SHAP values of the final model (res$Model), trained on the deconvolution subgroups computed on all Gide samples
shap_classification = compute_shap_values(model_trained = res$Model,
                                          task_type = "classification")

# Top deconvolution subgroups (mean |SHAP| across samples)
head(sort(colMeans(abs(shap_classification)), decreasing = TRUE), 10)
```

Save results
```{r}
save(res, pred, shap_classification, file = "evaluation/Groundtruth/Scenario3/Results/ML_analysis_results.RData")
```

Summary figure

Cross-validation AUROC of the algorithms compared (median and MAD across folds and repetitions) and ROC curve of the selected model on the external cohort.
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(pipeML)

load("evaluation/Groundtruth/Scenario3/Results/ML_analysis_results.RData")  # res, pred

cv = res$AUROC_median
cv$model = factor(cv$model, levels = rev(cv$model))

a = ggplot(cv, aes(Median_AUROC, model)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#2a78d6", width = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = Median_AUROC - MAD_AUROC, xmax = Median_AUROC + MAD_AUROC), height = 0.3) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +
  labs(x = "Cross-validation AUROC (median, MAD)", y = NULL, title = "Training: Gide")

roc = pred$Metrics
auc = unlist(pred$AUC)[1:3]

b = ggplot(roc, aes(fpr, Sensitivity)) +
  geom_abline(linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
  geom_step(color = "#c0392b", linewidth = 0.8) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.95, y = 0.08, hjust = 1, size = 3,
           label = paste0("AUROC = ", round(auc[1], 2), " (95% CI ", round(auc[2], 2), "-", round(auc[3], 2), ")")) +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +
  labs(x = "1 - Specificity", y = "Sensitivity", title = paste("Test: Riaz,", unique(roc$model)))

a + b + plot_layout(widths = c(1.2, 1))

ggsave("evaluation/Groundtruth/Scenario3/Results/auroc_summary.pdf", width = 9, height = 4)
ggsave("evaluation/Groundtruth/Scenario3/Results/auroc_summary.png", width = 9, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```
